intro: Next on Leftwitch's list for Kreldig Ungor is venom from the scorpashi and hides from aged kodo. Kreldig cannot say where to find either, since he does not know Desolace well.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Next on Leftwitch's list is... Let's see... Hmm. Oh, here it is.

Simple enough, but pretty explicit in his directions. He needs venom from the scorpashi, and hide from some kodo. The fine print says both are from specific creatures: the venom's got to come from any of the scorpashi, and the hide's got to come from an aged kodo, not the dying or ancient ones.
Mages, I tell ya, some of the stuff they want... It's just weird.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sorry I couldn't tell you where to find the kodo or the scorpashi. I'm not terribly familiar with the area, and I haven't had time to explore.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your help here's a boon, friend. You're cutting my time spent here in Desolace by half at least. I'll be back in Ironforge warming my feet in no time with your help.
When we get this list taken care of, and I'm back home, look me up, I'll buy you an ale for sure.
But until then, let's get the rest of these reagents gathered.
